snippet.title: Why Lombardi Quit Packers
snippet.description:
Why Lombardi Quit Packers
He walked away after five championships. Someone close to him says it was a mistake.

Vince Lombardi was 45 before anyone gave him a head coaching job. He turned a 1-10-1 Green Bay Packers team into five-time NFL champions, won the first two Super Bowls, then stepped down as head coach. This is the untold story of Vince Lombardi: the doubters, the Ice Bowl, the year he spent watching someone else coach, and his last season in Washington.

snippet.title: NEW: Person hospitalized after ICE shooting in New York
snippet.description:
Law enforcement sources tell FOX 5 NY that a shooting involving an ICE agent occurred near the Bronx earlier Thursday.

The NYPD posted about the incident on X earlier, saying that there was a shooting involving law enforcement agents in the Marble Hill neighborhood near the Bronx.

The post clarifies that the NYPD were not involved in the shooting. The person who was shot was taken to a hospital, and is now receiving medical attention.

In a post on X, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani said:

"This afternoon in Marble Hill, a New Yorker was shot by an ICE agent in a residential neighborhood. Early reports indicate agents surrounded him and a 5-year-old child in his car before firing multiple rounds. We believe the child was physically unharmed.

This is an unconscionable and incredibly serious situation. I have called the President; when we speak I will demand that he ends all ICE enforcement actions in our city. I will not stand by while ICE agents terrorize our communities.

Our thoughts are with the injured New Yorker and his family tonight. We are praying for his recovery.

Get ICE out of our neighborhoods. Get ICE out of our hospitals. Get ICE off our streets. Get ICE away from our children.

Abolish ICE."

snippet.description:

'낳아' 아니고 '나아'입니다.

받침이 없어야 하잖아요.

여러분 연인 혹은 소개팅 상대가 이렇게 문자를 보내온다면 어떨 것 같으세요?

한글날 맞아서 이런 맞춤법 실수가 호감도에 영향을 미칠 수 있다는 조사 결과를 가지고 왔습니다.

한 데이팅 앱이 이용자 518명을 대상으로 연애 상대 맞춤법 인식에 대해서 조사했습니다.

여성 응답자 가운데 10명 가운데서 7명이 맞춤법 자주 틀리는 연인과의 이별을 이해한다고 답을 했습니다.

반면 남자 응답자는 같은 의견을 보인 비율이 38.8%에 그쳤습니다.

여자가 조금 더 많았어요.

오히려 남자의 절반 가량은 맞춤법을 이유로 헤어지는 건 예민하다고 평가하기도 했습니다.

다만 이런 맞춤법에 민감하게 반응하는 이유는 상대방의 기본적인 지식 수준을 판단하게 된다는 점이 가장 많이 꼽혔습니다.

맞춤법 사용이 단순한 언어의 지식 문제를 넘어서 상대방에 대한 호감 소통에도 영향을 미칠 수 있다는 분석이죠.

snippet.title: GAYER SAI EM DEFESA DE DELTAN DALLAGNOL E DENUNCIA PERSEGUIÇÃO POLÍTICA NO TSE
snippet.description:
O deputado federal e senador eleito Gustavo Gayer (PL-GO) manifestou forte indignação diante da decisão do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) de cassar o mandato de Deltan Dallagnol. Em vídeo publicado nas redes sociais, Gayer classificou a medida como uma injustiça grave que expõe imperfeições profundas no sistema político e judiciário brasileiro. O parlamentar destacou que Dallagnol alcançou uma votação expressiva no Paraná, obtendo 25% dos votos mesmo sob severas restrições impostas durante a campanha eleitoral. Além disso, o deputado relatou episódios de suposta censura sofridos por ele próprio na reta final do pleito e associou a perda do mandato do ex-procurador a uma vingança política por sua atuação na Operação Lava Jato, conclamando seus apoiadores a resistirem em defesa da soberania das urnas.

A hot mic caught Vladimir Putin telling Xi Jinping that human organs can be continuously transplanted, and that living long enough might even mean achieving immortality. Now, Russia is reportedly pouring $26 billion into anti-aging research, including growing human organs inside genetically modified mini pigs, all overseen by a scientist obsessed with scanning Egyptian mummies. But this obsession with cheating death isn't new. Russian leaders have spent the better part of a century trying to achieve some form of eternal life, and their efforts have left behind some genuinely bizarre history. So how far back does Russia's quest for immortality actually go, and how much of it is really about the people, versus the man at the top?

snippet.title: Pronunciation Challenge 🗣 Can you pronounce these 5 words in English ✨️
snippet.description:
Pronunciation Challenge 🗣 Can you pronounce these 5 words in English ✨️

📝 Bureaucracy: A complicated system of rules and procedures, especially in government.
I spent all morning dealing with bureaucracy just to renew my permit.

📝 Tertiary: Coming third in order, importance, or level.
She was referred to a tertiary hospital for specialized treatment.

📝 Monotony: A lack of variety that becomes boring or repetitive.
The monotony of doing the same thing every day got to me.

📝 Harangue: A long, forceful, and angry speech.
My boss gave me a harangue about being late again.

📝 Accismus: Pretending to refuse something you actually want.
“I couldn’t possibly have the last slice,” while reaching for it, is accismus.
